title: 감사 인사: 도와줘서 고마워요
objective: You can thank someone with "-어서 고마워요" and answer when thanked.
summary: A student thanks a classmate for her help.
setting: A language school classroom before class. Tom missed class yesterday because he was sick. His classmate Mina lent him her notebook, and now Tom thanks her.

task.title: Give and answer thanks
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to complete each task in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: Thank you for showing me the way.
A: Thank you. B: Oh, it was nothing. Don't worry about it.
Could you lend me a pen?
Thanks to my teacher, I did well on the exam.
Is this cake? Thanks, I'll enjoy it!
This book helped me with my studies.

dialogue.korean: 미나 씨, 공책을 빌려줘서 정말 고마워요.
dialogue.meaning: Mina, thank you so much for lending me your notebook.
Oh, it was nothing. Are you feeling better now?
Yes, I'm fine. This is a small gift for you.

dialogue.korean: 네. 미나 씨가 커피를 좋아해서 샀어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes. I bought it because you like coffee.

exercises: Change the word in brackets to the -어서 / -아서 form: ① 파티에 (오다) 고마워요. ② 우산을 (빌려주다) 고마워요. ③ 음식이 (맛있다) 많이 먹었어요.
Choose the best reply. Use each reply once (잘 먹을게요 / 감사합니다 / 아니에요): ① 친구가 '숙제를 도와줘서 고마워요.'라고 했어요. ② 회사 동료가 빵을 줬어요. ③ 선생님이 길을 알려 주셨어요.
Answer in Korean using the dialogue: 톰 씨는 왜 커피를 샀어요?
Fill in the blank with 도움이 되다 in the past tense: 이 지도가 여행에 많이 ____.
answers: ① 와서 ② 빌려줘서 ③ 맛있어서
① 아니에요 ② 잘 먹을게요 ③ 감사합니다
미나 씨가 커피를 좋아해서 샀어요. (미나 씨가 커피를 좋아해서요.)
